usedFor: Habitify tracks habits, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers when “New Logs” appear.

bestTemplate.name: “New Logs” in Habitify, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Each new log can start a command you have set up on your own machine.

watchOut: “New Logs” in Habitify is polling, so “Trigger Command” starts after a scheduled check.
